'''Inducer cowlings''' were [[Starship/Legends|starship]] components. Because of the number of modifications aboard the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], an overheated inducer cowling was a known maintenance issue.<ref name="SWTSE">''[[Star Wars Trilogy Sourcebook, Special Edition]]''</ref>
